name: Therylune's Escape
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Help!

I was wandering around the Master's Glaive, and these dirty cultists surrounded me.  Lucky I'm good at hiding!!

Can you help me out of here?  And I need to send word to my sister Therysil that I'm all right.  She's in Ashenvale to the south, at the Shrine of Aessina.
narrative.objectives: Help Therylune escape, then tell Therysil at the Shrine of Aessina that her sister is safe.
narrative.offerRewardText:
My sister was where?? Therylune doesn't mind getting herself dirty, but still! That's a long way to wander, and the Master's Glaive is an unwholesome place...

Well thank you, adventurer. It was very nice of you to let me know she's all right.
narrative.endText: Escort Therylune away from the Master's Glaive
